skill.name: smc-chart-analysis
skill.description: Analyze Smart Money Concepts and ICT-style chart data through a local API. The skill identifies bias, liquidity, FVGs, sweeps, entries, stops, targets, setup grades, and risk warnings.
skill.summary: Analyzes SMC and ICT chart structure using local market data.
skill.author: AaronAbuUsama

security_audit.summary: Most static detections are false positives caused by Markdown fences, trading terminology, and localhost API examples. One medium issue remains because SKILL.md instructs running bun dev from an author-specific local path, which can execute local project scripts if followed automatically. No prompt injection, credential access, or third-party data exfiltration was found.

remediation.suggestion: Replace the author-specific bun dev command with setup prerequisites and require explicit user confirmation before running local commands.

remediation.issue: Local API dependency can be misunderstood
remediation.suggestion: State that requests should target localhost only and should not be changed to external URLs without user approval.

content.value_statement: Traders need structured context before acting on price charts. This skill turns SMC and ICT concepts into clear bias, levels, setup grades, and risk notes.
actual_capabilities: Fetches SMC data from a documented localhost API example.
Explains higher timeframe bias using premium and discount zones.
Identifies liquidity levels, fair value gaps, sweeps, BOS, and ChoCH context.
Builds long or short setup outlines with entry zones, stops, targets, risk-to-reward ratios, and setup grades.
Formats analysis with confluence checks, warnings, and a plain-language narrative.
Provides reference material for terminology, methodology, output fields, chart markup, and learning resources.
limitations: Requires a local web app API at localhost:3001 for live mechanical data.
Documents BTC/USDT, ETH/USDT, and SOL/USDT examples only.
Produces analysis, not financial advice or guaranteed outcomes.
SMC and ICT concepts are discretionary and may conflict with other methods.

use_cases.title: Review an intraday crypto setup
use_cases.description: Get a structured SMC readout for bias, liquidity, entry zone, stop, targets, and warnings.

use_cases.title: Teach market structure concepts
use_cases.description: Use consistent explanations for liquidity sweeps, fair value gaps, premium zones, discount zones, BOS, and ChoCH.

use_cases.title: Connect chart data to narrative analysis
use_cases.description: Turn local API output into a concise setup thesis with confluence grading and risk context.

prompt_templates.title: Analyze one market
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner request for a direct chart readout.
prompt_templates.prompt: Analyze BTC/USDT on the 1h timeframe using intraday style. Include bias, setup grade, entry zone, stop, targets, and warnings.

prompt_templates.title: Compare timeframes
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate request for bias and entry alignment.
prompt_templates.prompt: Analyze BTC/USDT on 4h and 15m timeframes. Compare higher timeframe bias with lower timeframe entry conditions.

prompt_templates.title: Challenge a setup
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced request for risk review before action.
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this SMC setup as a risk manager. Challenge the entry, invalidation, target logic, confluence grade, and reasons to skip.

prompt_templates.title: Build a full plan
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced request for a complete SMC trade plan.
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a complete SMC trade plan from the latest local API data. Include narrative, confluence checklist, killzone context, and risk warnings.

output_examples.input: Analyze BTC/USDT on 1h for an intraday setup.
output_examples.output: Bias: bullish. Setup grade: B+. Wait for a pullback into the unfilled bullish fair value gap. Use nearby structure for invalidation and target buy-side liquidity. Warning: price is in premium.

output_examples.input: Explain why an ETH setup is weak.
output_examples.output: The setup is C grade because higher timeframe bias is mixed, no fresh sweep is confirmed, and entry is away from discount. Wait for a clearer liquidity event.

output_examples.input: Create a confluence summary for SOL/USDT.
output_examples.output: The confluence summary separates aligned factors from concerns. It highlights structure direction, liquidity location, fair value gap quality, session timing, and conditions that invalidate the plan.

best_practices: Run the local API before requesting live chart analysis.
Ask for a specific symbol, timeframe, and trading style.
Treat every output as analysis and verify risk before trading.
anti_patterns: Using the output as guaranteed financial advice.
Requesting unsupported symbols without local API data.
Ignoring warnings because entries and targets look precise.

faq.question: Does this skill place trades?
faq.answer: No. It only prepares chart analysis and setup notes.

faq.question: Does it need internet access?
faq.answer: The skill examples call a local API. The separate web app may fetch market data through its own setup.

faq.question: Which markets are documented?
faq.answer: The examples document BTC/USDT, ETH/USDT, and SOL/USDT.

faq.question: Can it analyze multiple timeframes?
faq.answer: Yes. It can use separate local API requests for higher timeframe bias and lower timeframe entries.

faq.question: Is this financial advice?
faq.answer: No. The output is educational analysis and should include risk warnings.

faq.question: Which AI tools are supported?
faq.answer: The report lists support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.
